करोति तम् अहम् देवम् एकम् नौमि महेश्वरम्
घट
karoti tam ahaṃ devam ekaṃ naumi maheśvaram |
ghaṭa.. ||
The maker — him, I praise, the one God, Maheśvara the Lord.

टतो घटो यथा
paramāṇuvat |
ṭato ghaṭo yathā ||
Bodies and the rest have conscious cause, distinct-arranged — pots … like atoms.

niścito 'rtho 'sya |
saṃsthāne tasminn arthakriyācite. ||
Conscious-urged — or … […] as pot from [tha]t.

चक्षुरादौ तदौचित्याद् आत्मेष्टो संहतः परः
वह्निस्तत्प्रतिपत्त्यैव खादिरत्वेन सिद्ध्यति
cakṣurādau tadaucityād ātmeṣṭo 'saṃhataḥ paraḥ |
vahnistatpratipattyaiva khādiratvena siddhyati ||
… devoid of locus-form. Fixed is its meaning in place — in that action-heaped …
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
5
तथा वैचित्र्यमात्रेण न स्वलक्षणलक्ष्मणा
संस्थानमात्र एव
tathā vaicitryamātreṇa na svalakṣaṇalakṣmaṇā |
saṃsthānamātra eva.. ||
In the varied, the conscious alone is marked — as among pots. The maker, wise, resolved on varied use.

6
हेतुत्वम्
बुद्धिशालिनः
hetutvaṃ |
buddhiśālinaḥ. ||
There is, in function-yoking, among bodies and worlds, this distinct array — never from mere matter.
studio chant · gadya · align 0.0
7
स्वार्थतादिनिषेधेन साधिता पुरुषार्थता
तथा तथा परिणतिः स्यान् न किञ्चन दुर्घटम्
svārthatādiniṣedhena sādhitā puruṣārthatā |
tathā tathā pariṇatiḥ syān na kiṃcana durghaṭam ||
Here then — conscious makers proved, the Lord's act proved: for such-variety-knowers, lordlessness is impossible.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
8
निमित्तकारणम् नान्यत् पुरुषार्थोद्यमादृते
चित्तभूमेर् अधरतः शरीरादिविधिम् प्रति
nimittakāraṇaṃ nānyat puruṣārthodyamādṛte |
cittabhūmer adharataḥ śarīrādividhiṃ prati ||
Neither potter nor Lord shows agreement here — for him, opposition would follow, or agreement unproved.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0

कुत्र व्यापार ईश्वर्
tato 'tra |

10
तद्विना कुम्भकारेण घटो पि न भवेत् कथम्
अथ स्वभाव एषो स्य यत्कुलालाद्यपेक्षणम्
tadvinā kumbhakāreṇa ghaṭo 'pi na bhavet katham |
atha svabhāva eṣo 'sya yatkulālādyapekṣaṇam ||
As combination-ness is seen merely for another's sake — in the eye and the rest, by that fitness: the self-dear, uncompounded higher.

नैवोपादनहेत्वन्तः प्रवेशात्सहकारिभिः
लोकयात्रानुसन्धानवतीम् प्रज्ञाम् विना नहि स्थूलतामात्रमेव स्यान्नत्
naivopādanahetvantaḥ praveśātsahakāribhiḥ |

As from afar, from smoke, proving in a khadira-grove — fire is proved by just knowing it, as khadira-wood.

12
विना संवेद्यताम् पुंसस्तथात्वे पुरुषार्थता
अथापि मनसो वृत्तिर् बुद्धेर्वैकैकसंस्कृता स्यात्
vinā saṃvedyatāṃ puṃsastathātve puruṣārthatā |
athāpi manaso vṛttir buddhervaikaikasaṃskṛtā syāt ||
Thus the cause: locus-form alone, here distinguished — not by mere variety as svalakṣaṇa-mark.

13
किम् तु सा प्रधानस्य सामान्यस्याखिलान्प्रति

भाति वह्निर् निशीथे
